paite: Kaisaria ah mi khat amin Kornelia a-om a; amah Itali pawl achih uh, huai pawl a sepaih zaheutupa ahi.
heading: Peter Leh Kornelia

paite: Amah Pathian limsakmi ahi a, a-inkuanpihte tengteng toh Pathian laudan asiam uhi, mite kiang ah thilthawnpiak tampi ape zel a, Pathian kiang ah leng athum gige hi.
Hiai mi'n sun dak kuana ding khawng in mengmuhna in Pathian angel khat akiang ah alut a, "Kornelia" chi a asap lai chiangtak in amu hi.
Huan Kornelia in lau in amah ana en kilkel a, "Toupa, bang ahia?" achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Na thumnate leh na thilpiakte theihgigena ding in Pathian ma ah atungtouta hi.
Tu'n ah Joppa khua ah mi sawl inla, mi khat Simon Peter achih uh va pisak in;
amah huai tuipi gei a om, savunbawlpa Simon inn a tung ahi a, ama'n na hih ding hon na hilh ding hi," achi hi.
Ahoupihpa angel apaitak in, Kornelia in asikhate lak a mi nih leh anek bawl gigete lak a Pathian limsak sepaih khat asam hi.
Thu tengteng akiang ua ahilh khit in Joppa khua ah asawlta hi.
Huan azing nawn in, khopi zuan a pai, khua atun kuan un, thum ding in dak gukna vel in intung ah Peter akaltou hi.
heading: Peter Mengmuhna

paite: Huan agil ahong kial mahmahta a, an nek a-utta hi; himahleh nek ding abawl lai un ihmu bang in zeel in ahong om hi.
Van kihong in, banghiam bawm, puan liantak bang, ning li a khih, lei a luai a khaikhiak a om in amu hi.
Huai sung ah leitung a khe li nei ganhing chi chih leh gamsa leh ganhing bokvak, tungleng vasa chichihte a-om uhi.
Huan akiang ah aw in, "Peter, thou in gou inla, ne in," achi hi.
Himahleh Peter in, "Toupa hilou e; siang lou leh nin bangmah himhim ka ne ngei kei," achi hi.
Aw in, anihveina in, “Pathian in ahihsiangthousa nang siang lou chi ke'n," achi hi.
Huchibang ngen in thumvei ahong om a; huan van ah bawm khaitouh in a-om nawnta hi.
Huan Peter in mengmu bang a amuh theisiam lou a, abuai lai in, Kornelia mi sawlte'n Simon inn ana kankhia ua,
kongkhak bul ah ana dingh ua asam ua, "Simon, Peter achih uh, huai a atun leh tun louh," ana dong uhi.
Peter in mengmu bang a amuh angaihtuah lai inla, Kha in akiang ah, "Ngai in, mi thum in ahong zong uh.
Huaiziak in thou inla, kumsuk in, bangmah ginglel lou in amaute zui in; amau ka sawl ahi uh," achi hi.
Huchi in Peter huai mite kiang ah ahohsukta a, akiang uah, "Ngai un na mizon uh ka hi; bang ahia na hong nasan uh?" achi hi.

Amau, "Angel siangthou khat in, Kornelia, sepaih zaheutupa, midiktak, Pathian laudan siam, Juda nam tengteng lak a mihoih kiang ah, na thugen azakna ding in, a-inn ah nangmah sam ding in ahilh hi," achi uhi.
Huchi in mite asamlut a, agiaksakta hi. Huan azing in Peter athou a, akiang uah apai a, Joppa khomi unau kuate hiam leng akiang uah apai sam uhi.
Huan azing nawn in Kaisaria ah alutta uhi. Kornelia in, asanggamte leh alawm deihpente samkhawm in, amau ana ngak nilouh hi.
heading: Kornelia Inn Ah Peter

paite: Peter ahong lut dek laitak in Kornelia in ana dawn a, akhebul a bokkhup in, abia hi.
Himahleh Peter in amah akaithou a, dingh in, "Kei leng mihing mai ka hi,” achi hi.
Amah toh kihou kawm in alut a, mi tampi omkhawm amu hi.
Akiang uah, "Juda mi namdang toh kithuah leh pai asianlouhdan noumau mah in na thei uhi; himahleh kuamah siang lou leh nin ka chih ding ahi kei chih Pathian in ahon theisak hi.
Huaiziak in na hong saptak in sel lou in ka hong pai hi. Huchi in ka hon dong ahi, bangziak a hon sam na hi ua le?" achi hi.
Huan Kornelia in, “Ni li ahita, tu hun bang tan in, ka inn ah, dak kuana hun thumna ah ka thum a; ngai in, ka ma ah puan vaktak silh mi khat ahong dingh a,
'Kornelia, na thumna zak in a-omta, mi kiang a na thilthawnpiakte leng Pathian in atheigige hi.

Huaiziak in Joppa ah Simon, Peter achih uh, sam ding in mi sawl inla, na kiang ah sam in; amah tuipi gei ah savunbawlpa Simon inn a tung ahi, amah ahong tun chiang in na kiang ah thu agen ding hi,' achi hi.
Huaiziak in na kiang ah mi ka hon sawl pah hi; na hong pai ahoih ahi. Huchi in Toupa'n thu ahon piak peuhmah thei ding in tu'n ah Pathian mitmuh in i vek un hiai ah i om uhi," achi hi.
Huan Peter in agen a, "Pathian in mi deihsak tuam anei kei chih, diktak in ka thei hi.
heading: Kornelia Inn A Peter Thugen

paite: Himahleh nam chih lak ah kuapeuh amah kihtakdan siam a, diktak a gamta peuhmah, apahtak mi ahi naknak uhi.
Ama'n khamuanna tanchinhoih, Jesu Khrist tungtawn in Israel suante kiang ah agen a (amah mi tengteng Toupa ahi),
Johan in atangkou pihpih baptisma nung in, hiai tanchinhoih, Galili gam a kipan ahong thang pan a, Judia gam tengteng ah athangsuak a, noumau leng na thei uhi.

Nazaret Jesu tungtang thu, huchi a Pathian in amah Kha Siangthou leh thilhihtheihna a athaunilhdan, Pathian akiang a a-om ziak in amah mi tung a thil hoih hih leh diabol gawt tengteng hihdam in avialvak vak hi.
Judate gam ah leh Jerusalem a athilhih tengteng theihpihte ka hi uh, amah sing dawn ah khai in athat uhi.
Amah Pathian in ani thum ni in akaithou nawn a, chiantak in akitheisak hi.
Himahleh mi tengteng kiang ah ahi kei, Pathian in theihpih dia asehkholhte kiang kia ah ahi koute, misi lak a kipan athohnawn nung a akiang a ne a dawnte kiang ah.
Amah misi leh mihingte tung a Vaihawmpa dia Pathian seh ahi chih, mi kiang a tangkoupih leh theisak ding in Pathian in thu ahon pia hi.
Kuapeuh amah gingta amin ziak in khelhnate ngaihdam in a-om ding uh chih hiai a tanchin zawlnei tengteng in ana theihsak det uh ahi,” achi hi.
Peter in huai thu agen laitak in thuzate tengteng tung ah Kha Siangthou ahong tung hi.
heading: Zentelte Tung A Kha Siangthou Tunna

paite: Zeksumte lak a agingtate Peter hon zui peuhmah in Kha Siangthou thawnniak Zentelte tung ah leng sunbuak ahih ziak in lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
Paute a thu gen in Pathian phat in aza uhi.
Huan Peter in apuang a, "Hiai mite, eimah bang a Kha Siangthou tang sam, baptisma ding in tui zat kuama'n akham thei dia hia?" achi hi.
Huchi in Toupa min a baptisma tan ding thu apia hi. Huai khit in ni bangzah hiam taam ding in akhou uhi.
